notes_for_editor: Built date 1934 agrees between the register and the Truckee-Donner article (plaque photo). Visit reports disagree on staffing (2009 staffed, 2010 not, 2015 staffed) and on road needs (2009 two-wheel-drive possible; 2015 4x4 recommended). The 2009 visit report says 10 miles north of Downieville, while the Truckee-Donner article says northwest; the story reports both. The access level public rests on one 2015 visitor comment. No current (2020s) staffing or access source was found; the ArcGIS StoryMaps Lost Sierra Route page returned no text. The brief's kind enclosed_tower was left unchanged: the register describes a live-in cab on a short tower, which does not clearly contradict it. The asbestos mention comes only from the register's description and was not checked elsewhere. No photos added. Fact-check 2026-10-08: the staffed comment, the early-morning account and the two-wheel-drive comment all come from the one 2009 visit report (Oct 17, 2009), not from two separate 2009 visitors. The 2010 and 2015 reports are separate. The register says the last mile is a bit steep, not steep.
